name: FAB 4200
workRule: keccak256(chainId32 || contract20 || minter20 || nonce32) with leadingZeroBits >= floor
retarget: EMA on mint cadence, 16-mint window, +2 fast-clamp vs bursts, per-wallet +2 escalation
fallbackRenderer: ownerless recovery renderer; tokenURI try/catch never bricks

selectors.renderSVG(bytes32,uint8,uint8,bool,uint1: computable via keccak; the site derives it at runtime

renderer.architecture: four ownerless immutable contracts: FAB4200Renderer (primary) -> FAB4200Interiors + FAB4200Decor; FallbackRenderer for recovery

genesisAllocation: none — supply starts at 0; every token is mined by proof-of-work
royalty: 500 bps to an immutable address that receives no tokens
